notes: settings, reorganised: ten sections that each do one job — General (proxy + appearance), Model, Permissions (per-tool overrides merged in from Tools), Workspace (.gitignore, AGENTS.md and file history, out of Security), Web access (who the app talks to, search, fetching, updates), Privacy & data (Security and Data merged); every control now has the shape of the thing it holds — switches that say what the current value means, sliders for temperature and compaction (0.7 now reads "70% of the window"), steppers with units, a revealable API key, a table for model prices instead of raw JSON — and the knobs nobody touches sit behind Advanced; old deep links to the previous section names still work
